name: Dumbbell Triceps Extension
how_to:
Step 1: Setup
- Choose a dumbbell with a manageable weight.
- Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart for stability.
- Grip the dumbbell with both hands, placing your palms under the top plate of the dumbbell.
Step 2: Lifting the Dumbbell
- Lift the dumbbell overhead, keeping your arms fully extended.
- Your elbows should be close to your ears, pointing forward.
- Engage your core and glutes to stabilize your body.
Step 3: Lowering Phase
- Slowly bend your elbows, lowering the dumbbell behind your head.
- Keep your elbows stationary and avoid letting them flare out.
- Lower the weight until your forearms are parallel to the floor or slightly deeper.
Step 4: Pressing Phase
- Engage your triceps and press the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
- Fully extend your arms while keeping tension in the triceps.
- Repeat for the desired number of reps.
Repetitions and Sets:
- Beginners: 3 sets of 8 to 10 reps
- Intermediate: 3 to 4 sets of 10 to 12 reps
- Advanced: 4 sets of 12 to 15 reps
